name: RSWM Ltd
title: RSWM Ltd - 500350 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell 9.1% YoY to ₹1,142 cr, but FY26 EBITDA rose 40.5% to ₹327 cr on margin 7.1%, with capacity cut at Chhata and utilisation guided up 7–10% from Q4 levels.

utilisation.quote: We currently are able to utilise +80%, and we can improve it further to 85% to 90% to optimise our operations.

capex.quote: we are having ₹92 crores of expansion in our knitting business. We are adding printing as one of the segments.

triggers.label: Chhata spinning curtailed (~₹250 cr revenue)
triggers.quote: Operations of Chhata spinning were curtailed, which was having inefficient production

triggers.label: Mélange utilisation 65–70% → 85–90%
triggers.quote: In mélange yarn, the utilisation is to the tune of 65% to 70%, which we expect to go back to 85% to 90% level

triggers.label: Denim gas and yarn cost lag
triggers.quote: passing on it to the customer always takes time , and there is a lag. So, to that extent, our margins and the spreads are impacted in denim.

triggers.label: US orders still only 'under recovery'
triggers.quote: So, I will say that it is under recovery.

guidance.value: current quarter slightly better or equivalent to last quarter
guidance.quote: the current quarter is going to be slightly better or equivalent to last quarter
we are definitely expecting EBITDA improvement by 3% to 4% in the current levels

guidance.metric: Utilisation uplift across mélange, denim, knit
guidance.quote: there is a potential to improve utilisation between 7% to 10% in the coming quarters

guidance.value: operational in Q1 FY27 (construction from mid-May)
guidance.quote: we want to make it operational next year, the 1st Quarter of the financial year

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT boosted by one-off deferred tax reversal
red_flags.quote: there is an impact of ₹23 crores for the deferred tax liability , which we reversed

red_flags.label: Gas cost upward revision unresolved
red_flags.quote: the cost has significantly gone for upward revision. So, that is a challenge

red_flags.label: Working capital ~₹800 cr; term loans ~₹700 cr
red_flags.quote: if you talk about the working capital, it's close to around ₹800 crores

evasions.quote: as on today, we are not mapping this exactly the way you are saying, but I would accept that it is not high in numbers.
we focused more on the profitability than pure revenue
